notes.title: The History Update
notes.notes: Veronica has more backstory now... so we've added a little colour!

notes.title: Expelled Demo now available!
notes.notes:
If you've been considering checking out the new Overboard! game - EXPELLED! - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963890/Expelled/]you can now try it for free with the demo[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40654701/f56271c0af2a6a3ad2cf23361fc3feeacf64a6e5.png[/img]

Verity Amersham is about to have the worst day of her life. She's innocent -- but everyone says she's guilty! 

Can YOU help her escape justice -- and better yet, deliver it to someone who deserves it? 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963890/Expelled/]Check out the demo on the main Expelled! page here[/url].

notes.title: Oh no! DEMOnic Malcolm's been EXPELLED from the boat!
notes.notes:
It's 1935 and Veronica Villensey is about to be separated from her husband - by a large body of water. 

It's not the FIRST time she's had to be pushy to get what she wants, of course. It's not the first time she had to stop at nothing. Like every PREFECT villain (or hero?) this lady's got BACKSTORY. 

We would hate for you to MISS out on LEARNING about it..?

notes.title: New Overboard! game incoming!
notes.notes:
Prepare yourself for more blackmail, mayhem and manipulation with the next game in the Overboard! franchise, out on March 12th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40654701/461fe42b46d7d860edfe5202f80d3881dca9821d.jpg[/img]

It's 1922, and Verity Amersham is about to be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963890/]expelled![/url] from Miss Mulligatawney's School - unless she can find someone to take the fall for a terrible attack on a School Prefect. Lie, cheat, steal - but don't get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963890/]EXPELLED![/url]

With more characters to investigate, more leads, and more danger, Miss Mulligatawney's School promises secrets, discoveries - and great rewards for detective who dig deep enough. Just... don't get caught.

notes.title: Miss Mulligatawney's School for Promising Girls
notes.notes:
When we wrote Overboard! in 2021, we wanted to make a Christie-style detective game that was characterful, funny, puzzley, and quick to get into. No menus, points or systems - just the drama and the dialogue (and the disasters along the way). 

Three years later and we've back at it with our next title... Built using the same real-time storytelling technology, but with more characters, more plotilnes, more intrigue, and more mysteries to unravel... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40654701/1d8b82fc113ffb688723a2405f1dc00332956736.gif[/img]

So if that sounds interesting, pop over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963890]Steam page here[/url] and hit the Wishlist button, to be sure to hear when the game is ready!

notes.title: Haven't met Veronica yet? Now's the time
notes.notes:
If you haven't played Overboard! yet - the reverse whodunnit where you are the femme fatale - then now might be the perfect time to do it. Veronica's pushed her husband overboard - but without your help, it's Sing Sing as soon as the boat lands in New York. 

We're just saying, this might not be the last we've seen of her...

notes.title: Going overboard about Overboard!
notes.notes: Come and hang out with [i]Overboard![/i]'s narrative lead, Jon Ingold, as he plays the game and digs up its secrets: how it was made, what bits slipped through, which bits got left out. Murder mystery design, characters, dialogue, and generally being excited about interactive narrative.

notes.title: ¡Échale el muerto a otro!
notes.notes:
Here at inkle we make games with lots of words, that combine together in complicated ways. Every  playthrough of one of our games is different - sometimes a little, sometimes a lot. That's always meant that we've been afraid to try translation. 

Until now. 

Thanks to the efforts of a single, fan translator, as of today, [i]Overboard![/i] is now fully playable in Spanish, so now you can lie, cheat, steal, murder, blackmail and burgle in the language of Cervantes and Picasso. 

¡Disfrutad!

The translation has been achieved by creating an entirely new copy of the game's 30,000 word script, and weaving the translation into the existing logic and gameplay mechanisms: meaning the translator needed to be fluent in not two languages, but three - English, Spanish, and ink.

notes.title: Overboard! up for 2 awards at the IGF!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that Overboard! has been nominated for two [url=https://igf.com/article/unpacking-and-inscryption-lead-igf-2022-nominations]IGF awards![/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40654701/146242a5241bc5d00d447750763b93dfd999579f.png[/img]

The game was nominated for [i]Excellence in Design[/i] and [i]Excellence in Narrative[/i]. It also received Honourable Mentions for the Grand Prize, and for the Audio category (a good thing we can't win that, as Thomas Edison and Rachmaninoff aren't around to collect it.)

The results will be announced towards the end of March. With previous wins for Narrative for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/774201/Heavens_Vault/]Heaven's Vault[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/381780/80_Days/]80 Days[/url], we're crossing our fingers for the triple!

notes.title: Update'o'clock! It's V1.2.2!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone submitting bug reports over the weekend - we're delighted to have fixed everything submitted, and it's not even yet lunchtime!

[list]
[*] The flipping profanity filter now persists across runs, and even across a full reset
[*] Exorcised a few ghosts who were returning from the dead
[*] Assorted minor story fixes
[*] Fixed a rare bug where an image panel appeared over the map
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the clock didn't reset fully on restarting
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 (for real, this time!)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We're delighted you've been enjoying our tale of deception, seduction, and murder as much we enjoyed making it. 

Special thanks to everyone who reported issues from the in-game bug reporter or via our [url=https://discord.gg/inkle]discord[/url]; this should fix everything we've heard about so far! 

[list]
[*] Added a pause menu setting to disable screen flashes
[*] Tweaked some images of hands to fit the correct characters
[*] Fixed a bug where the clock wouldn't reset on jumping overboard
[*] Fixed ending where Clarissa could return from the dead to (successfully) protest her innocence
[*] Fixed a crash caused by Veronica getting completely tongue-tied by the Commander's dashing handsomeness
[*] Assorted minor story fixes and typos, including the truly remarkable correct spelling of Connecticut
[/list]
